description: Per-rule acceptance, rejection, weighted eFP and the demotion test's inputs (spec §9.2, §9.4, §12.5). Aggregates only; links go to GitHub.

panels.description: Over the dashboard's time range. Wilson is the 95% lower bound of unweighted precision over judged findings; demotion needs eFP above the bar and Wilson below the floor (§9.4).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.rule_id AS "Rule", m.status AS "Status", m.owner AS "Owner", o.lane AS "Lane",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen) AS "Posted",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND o.accepted) AS "Accepted",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND o.rejected) AS "Rejected",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND o.ignored) AS "Ignored",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.human_agreed) AS "Human agreed",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND o.accepted)::numeric
        / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND (o.accepted OR o.rejected OR o.ignored)), 0), 3) AS "Acceptance",
  round(sum(o.neg_w)::numeric / nullif(sum(o.neg_w + o.pos_w), 0)::numeric, 3) AS "eFP (weighted)",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.pos_w > 0 OR o.neg_w > 0) AS "Judged",
  round(w.wilson::numeric, 3) AS "Wilson lower",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.owner_overturned) AS "Overturned"
FROM finding_outcomes o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ru.status, ru.owner FROM rule_runs rr
  JOIN rules ru ON ru.rule_id = rr.rule_id AND ru.version_sha = rr.rule_version
  WHERE rr.rule_id = o.rule_id ORDER BY rr.id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE
    (p + 1.959964^2/(2*n) - 1.959964*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + 1.959964^2/(4*n*n))) / (1 + 1.959964^2/n) END AS wilson
  FROM (SELECT count(*)::float8 AS n,
               CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.neg_w <= j.pos_w)::float8 / count(*) END AS p
        FROM finding_outcomes j WHERE j.rule_id = o.rule_id AND (j.pos_w > 0 OR j.neg_w > 0) AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at)) c) w ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
GROUP BY o.rule_id, o.lane, m.status, m.owner, w.wilson
ORDER BY "eFP (weighted)" DESC NULLS LAST, "Posted" DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT week AS "time", rule_id AS "metric", acceptance_rate::float8 AS "acceptance"
FROM rule_weekly_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(week) AND acceptance_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT week AS "time", rule_id AS "metric", effective_fp_weighted::float8 AS "eFP"
FROM rule_weekly_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(week) AND effective_fp_weighted IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
